title: Enrollment code display, Crockford check symbol, parsing
spec: Implement EnrollmentCode::check_symbol, to_display and parse as the module and method docs say. The 160-bit secret is 32 Crockford characters (5 bits each, most significant first). Parse order: strip hyphens and whitespace, uppercase, require prefix CC1 (else BadPrefix), map O->0 and I/L->1, require exactly 33 characters (else BadLength), reject characters outside the alphabet in the 32 data characters (BadCharacter; U is never data), then the check symbol must equal the computed one (BadChecksum). No new dependencies.
